title: FFXIV 1.23b World Chat client wire contract

coordinateSystem.description: Application offsets are relative to the byte after the 16-byte actor wrapper and the 8-byte game-message header.

framing.outerFrame: Ordinary outer frame containing an actor-wrapped game-message subpacket.
framing.distinction: Raw World Chat framing does not translate tell or selected-group chat into Map opcode 0x0003.

fields.name: target_name
fields.bounds: At most 31 content bytes plus NUL.

fields.name: message
fields.bounds: At most 511 content bytes plus NUL.

fields.name: display_name
fields.semanticBoundary: Client code proves only that these bytes become the displayed name, not authoritative sender identity.

fields.name: selected_group_entry_token
fields.semanticBoundary: FUN_006C0590 selects this full u32 from a Group-owned entry table. It is not proven to be an actor, party, linkshell, or sender identifier.

fields.name: message
fields.bounds: At most 511 content bytes plus NUL.

fields.name: selected_group_entry_token
fields.semanticBoundary: FUN_006C13D0 matches the full token against a Group-record u32 vector at +0x74. A miss returns zero and drops the message. A match index selects a u16 presentation value from a secondary node range at +0x28. The token allocation domain and presentation enum remain unresolved.

fields.name: sender_name
fields.semanticBoundary: Displayed sender name only; no second sender identity field is proven.

dispatch.displayTypeSource: u16 return from selected Group entry-token lookup

stringContract.behavior: The bounded copy reserves one byte for NUL and backs over UTF-8 continuation bytes so truncation does not split a multibyte sequence.
stringContract.limit: This is bounded-copy behavior, not strict Unicode validation.

validation.emptyTellTarget: Rejected before send when FUN_00445E50 returns zero.
validation.emptyTellMessage: Accepted by the client send path; FUN_004DF810 checks only target nonemptiness before building the packet.
validation.emptySelectedGroupMessage: Accepted by the client send path; FUN_00C99B80 treats an initial NUL as success and no later nonempty check precedes FUN_004DF6D0.
validation.tellReceiveNulTermination: Embedded NUL terminates displayed text. The tell receive path passes -1 to the string assignment helper, so an absent NUL is not bounded by the packet extent and the overread extent remains unresolved.
validation.selectedGroupReceiveNulTermination: Embedded NUL terminates displayed text. The selected-group receive path copies fixed 0x20-byte name and 0x200-byte message fields and appends destination NULs, so a complete field without an embedded NUL remains bounded. The callback has no packet-length argument, so short-packet read safety remains unresolved.
validation.controlEncoding: FUN_00C99E40 -> FUN_00C99B80 requires the 0x03 terminator for handled 0x02 controls and rejects command bytes >=0x37, types 0x00 and 0xFF, types 0xD8..0xEF, and a zero handler result. Extended types 0xF0..0xFE read fixed bytes without an input-length check, so truncated-input safety remains unresolved.
validation.plainTextEncoding: FUN_00445C70 rejects malformed UTF-8 continuation patterns after each plain segment. This is byte-level validation, not proof of full Unicode conformance.

selectedGroupTokenBoundary.finding: The 0x00C9 +0x08 u32 is a selected Group entry token. FUN_006C0590 reads it from a Group-owned table, FUN_006C13D0 matches it in a Group-record vector at +0x74, and the match index selects a u16 presentation value from a secondary node range at +0x28. FUN_006CBDD0 copy-constructs the +0x70 token vector for both ordinary EntryBuilder and linkshell-specific EntryLinkShellBuilder implementations.

linkshellBoundary.finding: The 0x00C9 send route is the literal group command route and obtains a selected Group entry token and presentation value through the Group subsystem. The ordinary EntryBuilder and linkshell-specific EntryLinkShellBuilder both construct the same +0x70 token-vector mechanism through FUN_006CBDD0. This proves mechanism compatibility, but no static edge joins the chat ExecuteParameters to a linkshell-backed Group or active-linkshell state, so player-linkshell reuse remains an unresolved candidate rather than a proven client route.
linkshellBoundary.proofBoundary: No new retail capture can be produced. Promotion would require discovery of an archived retail linkshell specimen or a static producer edge that ties the group ExecuteParameters to active-linkshell state. Testing against a reconstructed server can prove interoperability only.
